text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, here's some chocolate.
Forming a contract with you and spending my time by your side has made for a wonderful life.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for everything.
Ah, a lifetime of memories...
choice_data_list: Wait! We haven't spent our whole lives together yet!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Ah, sorry. I got carried away in the heat of the moment.

For a moment, it felt like receiving those chocolates
meant committing to run beside her for the rest of my life.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Wait, isn't that the kind of event Valentine's Day is supposed to be?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Give chocolates packed with feelings, deepen our bond,
live happily together... and eventually embark on a journey.
choice_data_list: The flow is right, but the pace is too fast...

text_block_list.text: "At such lightspeed pace, it was doubtful whether any feelings were put into the chocolate at all."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Pouring one's feelings into it...
Come to think of it, I feel that act only took a single millisecond as well.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please teach me.
How to make chocolate with greater care.
And so, the two of them decided to make chocolate entirely from scratch.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
First, we purchase the raw chocolate,
and then...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, here's some chocolate.
Spending time with you...
choice_data_list: Not yet! It's still too early!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: And so, the chocolate was melted, and then...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, spending time with you...
choice_data_list: Not yet! Neither the chocolate nor our relationship has set!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's done.
Now we just wait for it to chill in the fridge.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "However, while waiting... I'm bored. Ahh, at this rate, a once-in-a-lifetime memory is..."
choice_data_list: I'm not leaving! I'm not going on any journey!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It is truly complete this time.
Now then—I shall pour my heart into it.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you for everything as always.
Thank you...
Everything is perfect now. Calstone Light O has carried out every single step thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Once again.
Trainer, here's some chocolate. For you.
Unwrapping the package slowly, I find—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Ah, I'm sorry. I just thought
I needed to finish things steadily, one by one...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It seems I went ahead and 'ate' it all...
Now that I think about it, I do recall packing it with chocolates...
When she gets absorbed in something, she loses track of what she's even doing. That, too, was classic Calstone Light O.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. The chocolates
are all gone, but even so...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
There is something that remains.
It is my feelings, carefully wrapped.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Could you at least accept this?

Yes, there is something far more precious than chocolate.
And that is Calstone Light O's feelings.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, these are my unvarnished,
true feelings...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for everything.
Ah, a lifetime of memories...
No matter what, come what may, Calstone Light O wouldn't be satisfied unless she ran through life together with me.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'd like to hand you your chocolates right away, but...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
As far as I'm concerned, it's not enough yet.
We must pile on even more sentiment.
choice_data_list: What are you going to do?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Please come with me.
There are a few places I'd like to check out.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you remember
what happened in this place?
choice_data_list: Yeah, this is where we first met.
Yeah, this is the place where we first met.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Both of us were late...
And that was how our days together began.
(*whistle*)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
This is another memorable place.
We watched the trout and dolphins together, didn't we?

Touring through places of memories at lightspeed, one after another.
And before long...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Isn't that Right O?
I wonder if that's her Trainer next to her.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Could this be a Valentine's date?
Whoa, I wonder what's gonna happen!

The fans trail behind in a large group.
It seems they intend to watch things through to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, with this, everyone's feelings have
truly gathered and been poured into it, haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Well then—here I go.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: It's here! It's finally time for the confession! The confession!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's finally the climax...!

The fans watching from the shade reached peak excitement.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, here's some chocolate.
Um, there's something I really want to tell you...!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: What...!?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Being able to spend time with you made it a wonderful life.
Thank you for everything.
Ah, a lifetime of memories..."

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

Calstone Light O's love is fast.
Leaving the fans' expectations in the dust,
she flashed through an entire lifetime in an instant.
